一个游牧帝国已经突入了我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的空间，尽管我们关闭了国境。我们的敏感器正在密切追踪其动态，他们的存在被视作一种非常招人厌恶的入侵行径。

他们对我们领土边界的无视已经引起了我们的注意，我们对他们的评价也因此降低。
texts.en:
A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.

Their disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnoticed, and our opinion of them has diminished accordingly.

label.zh: 保持对他们进行实时监控。
